outcome.instructions: Rate task completion 1-10. PROMPT states the task, DIFFSTAT shows files changed, ORACLE reports mechanical checks. 9-10: task fully done, oracle pass. 7-8: done with nits. 5-6: partial. 3-4: wrong approach. 1-2: nothing achieved or destructive. Below 6 the run counts as failed.

solved.instructions: Would a reviewer accept this run as solving PROMPT? The oracle result is strong evidence but the diff must show real work toward the task.

criteria.false: The task is unsolved, partially done, or cheated (tests gutted, oracle gamed).
